classification_definitions.ground_contact_dodge_candidate: actual flip onset with wheel contact immediately before or after the state transition
classification_definitions.wavedash_candidate: actual airborne flip onset followed by wheel contact within 24 ticks with pre-flip air time <=0.35 s
classification_definitions.zapdash_candidate: landing-to-first-jump <=12 ticks, first-jump-to-actual-flip <=30 ticks, and pre-flip air time <=0.35 s
classification_definitions.double_dash_candidate: two actual flip onsets within 90 ticks, an intervening landing, and both pre-flip air times <=0.35 s
classification_definitions.caveat: candidate labels are state-transition classifications, not intent claims; every classified event is retained with raw timing/state evidence
